notes.title: Submerged: Hidden Depths is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40932260/39ecbf8bdfb51feed9f3c723ae1b7c8c93f369df.gif[/img]

Sit back, relax, and explore Submerged: Hidden Depths. Now on Steam, PlayStation, and Xbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40932260/b48b1892bfa939379ba0ac3fe3c1fafaaee8d720.gif[/img]

The long-awaited sequel to Submerged has now been launched on your favourite platforms. Pick up a copy of Submerged: Hidden Depths today and join Miku and Taku on a relaxing and explorative adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40932260/fb8475b9733531f54c1b957ad73d8c801d06df81.gif[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Submerged: Hidden Depths release date!
notes.notes:
[h1]Set sail on March 10th as Submerged: Hidden Depths launches on Steam.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40932260/90d88c3011b0f14e4403257c273e8c74d84ce3bc.jpg[/img]

Set in a breathtaking city gripped by a dark mystery, Submerged: Hidden Depths is an adventure exploration game that sees players climb the ruins of lost skyscrapers to uncover the tale of the sunken city, while taking in its beauty and tranquility. Protagonists Miku and Taku have their own history with the darkness and whilst one wants to use it for good, the other fears it will tear them apart.
